title: How should incoming balls be divided between two tempering furnaces serving one rolling line?
summary: An 80–100 mm rolled-ball tempering-line project places an adjustable splitter at the pre-tempering air-cooler outlet. One branch feeds the associated tempering furnace; the other leads to another furnace 14 m away. The split must match both receiving capacities. Both branches cannot simultaneously be assigned the whole line's output.
